claim.why_it_matters: A top-level heading that the page does not print is appended to the Annex G page; the Bibliography heading belongs to page 926, so the stray H1 misplaces document structure.

verdict.reasoning: The rendered page 925 (printed 901) does end after 'This error has not been fixed because doing so may cause unacceptable incompatibilities.' and the markdown carries all of its text. But '# Bibliography and index' is not page content misplaced from page 926. It is one of five transcription-level part dividers in specs/ISO_COBOL_2014.md ('# Preface' l.1, '# Front matter...' l.60, '# Clauses 1 to 16' l.1036, '# Annexes A to G' l.29128, '# Bibliography and index' l.36337), each placed immediately before the first '## Page N' marker of its part. Here it sits directly above '## Page 926', which carries the page's own printed heading '### BIBLIOGRAPHY (informative)'. The standard prints none of these H1 titles; they are navigation scaffolding the transcription adds, and the page workunit only attributes it to p925 because it falls before the next page marker. No printed text is missing, added or moved, and the meaning does not change.
